metadata.description: Nerd4Rent open-source skills, agents and hooks for daily developer workflows (Cursor plugin marketplace).

plugins.name: nerd4rent
plugins.description: Daily developer workflow automation — bootstrap new projects with git, GitHub, Linear, and spec-creating skills; write well-specified Linear issues and drive them through a status-driven plan-implement-review workflow; mechanically start an issue (branch, empty commit, draft PR/MR with the Fixes magic word) and close it out (commit, push, merge PR/MR, set Done); resume a project from its last nerdbrain checkpoint, verified against git and Linear; bootstrap the CLIs those skills require.
